event: Born Aug 29, Gary, Indiana; father a steel-mill crane operator
Jackson 5 formed; father's rigorous fear-based rehearsal regime begins

source: Detroit Historical Society - Encyclopedia of Detroit: Jackson 5

event: Signs with Motown Mar 11, 1969; brothers relocated to Los Angeles
source: Detroit Historical Society - Encyclopedia of Detroit: Jackson 5

event: I Want You Back hits #1 on Billboard Hot 100, Jan 31, 1970; childhood becomes full-time work
source: Motown Classic - Jackson 5 I Want You Back

event: Off the Wall released Aug 10, 1979 - first real creative-control push
Scalp burned filming Pepsi commercial, Jan 27, 1984; widely reported as start of painkiller use
Moonwalk publishes his own account of the beatings and fear; buys Neverland
Oprah interview, Feb 10, 1993: describes crying from loneliness, fear of his father, getting sick when he saw him
source: Oprah.com - Oprah Reflects on Her Interview with Michael Jackson
